Curiosity, at your own pace.

What can I experience now?

Book a stay in the house and ask the hosts to arrange a conversation about its hempcrete construction and natural materials. Agree any guided time, fees and inclusions before booking.

Are farm walks and the Experience Center open?

They are part of our next chapter and are not yet offered as confirmed visitor facilities. Ask about progress and seasonal opportunities when planning your dates.

Do I need to join activities?

No. Quiet leisure stays remain at the heart of the home. You can simply enjoy the mountains, read and rest. Learning sessions and group activities are arranged separately.

PLEASE HONOUR OUR VILLAGE

Peace is part of the welcome.

Drinking alcohol is prohibitedNo loud music or partiesNo disruptive noise

Our home belongs to a living village. Please respect local traditions, neighbours and the quiet surroundings that make this place special.
